title: The smallest MCP server
concept: Register and discover one read-only tool over stdio.

title: Versioned retrieval
concept: Filter a local corpus before returning bounded source evidence.

title: Schemas and honest errors
concept: Separate a valid no-match, invalid arguments, and unsupported domain input.

title: A remote-capable transport
concept: Serve the same kind of tool over actual loopback HTTP.

title: Verify a resource-bound token
concept: Check signature, issuer, expiry, audience and required scope on HTTP requests.

title: Authorization code + PKCE
concept: Discover the resource and issuer, explicitly approve a fixture consent, exchange a single-use code, and call MCP.

title: Authorize the object
concept: Derive the tenant from validated token claims, not a tool argument.

title: Publish with a revision precondition
concept: Separate a read from an explicit write and atomically reject stale edits in SQLite.

title: Observe outcomes without raw chats
concept: Write allowlisted JSON events for success and a simulated dependency failure.

title: Work that survives disconnects
concept: Persist a queued job, run an external worker, restart the MCP server, and poll owned state.

title: Recover an ambiguous write
concept: Atomically commit a document revision and its operation outcome in SQLite.

title: Bound tenant consumption
concept: Use an atomic per-tenant budget that persists across server processes.

title: Prepare reproducible review evidence
concept: Discover actual tool metadata and execute five positive/three negative fixture scenarios.

title: Keep old callers working
concept: Add a new optional field while continuing to accept the old request shape.
